title: protocol(pm): a suspended seat account is a dead session whose comments are gone — the takeover path, re-rendered records, `pm:retriage` for vanished triage, and durable state in bodies or under the App identity
body:
③ 直派任务 — maintainer direct dispatch, filed by the director seat (summon #27, `session_0129ZpnaBcYZZ51rCvQiXg6C`). `domain:skills` · `tooling` (the PM loop's own protocol, `.claude/**`, Tier S at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`). Ruled by the director on the maintainer's word 「已经封过好几个号,你不用管具体的,只要决定怎么处理」 (2026-09-23); dispatched by this seat when the serial constraint below clears.
Blocked-by: #19061
Unlock-action: re-check #19061 when label pm:dispatched absent

**Provenance (who / verbatim / where):** the objectui `domain:spec` seat reported 12 triage comments gone from 11 cards; the maintainer: 「评论被删应该是因为封号」, then 「已经封过好几个号」. Measured by the director seat at 2026-09-23T03:03Z: a platform suspension hides every comment of the account fleet-wide and leaves **no** `comment_deleted` timeline event (104 recently updated cards in both repos scanned: zero events); the account's **assignee** field, its **PRs** and every **body** it edited persist. A sweep of all 31 open `pm:dispatched` cards found only three without a `Claim:` comment, none of them a suspension casualty — the damage is to comment history (triage notes, claims, reports, `## Contract review` records), not to labels or bodies.

## Ruling — the fleet's handling of a suspended seat account (standing, ⛔ not per-case)

1. **A suspended account is a dead session, by construction.** The dead-session path in `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈接手中断的 dev〉 applies unchanged: liveness is read from GitHub output only, and an account whose comments have vanished and whose token no longer reads has produced nothing since — the taker re-claims. ⛔ No unbanning, ⛔ no reuse, ⛔ no new personal seat accounts: the fleet's writing identity is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay (#19701, #19755, #19774), and a local checkout writes through `with-fleet.sh` with the App token.
2. **Vanished records are re-rendered on the current head, never assumed.** A `## Contract review` of record that disappeared with its author does not exist for the queue guard; the landing seat renders a new one on the current head before enqueuing. A `Claim:` that disappeared is re-posted by the taker (as the bot). A ruling comment that disappeared is re-recorded from the card body's `Ruled:` line (bodies persist — this is why the body carries it).
3. **Vanished triage is re-triaged, not reconstructed.** Cards whose triage comment vanished get `pm:retriage` (one label write per card; any seat may hang it); the triage seat re-grades them at first touch, writing as the bot. ⛔ Nobody dispatches on a grading that cannot be read.
4. **Durability rule.** State that must survive an account event lives in a **body** (card `Ruled:` / `Blocked-by:` / `Unlock-action:` lines, seat-post status block) or is written **as the App**. Comments by a personal account are not durable and are never the only carrier of a state. A seat-post body must therefore stay writable through the relay (≤ 60,000 bytes — #19755's size route covers the over-cap write as the seat's user, which is exactly the non-durable case to avoid): shrink the body, per the director's ruling on the triage seat's report.
5. ⛔ Not ruled here: which accounts, when, or why — the maintainer's, and not the fleet's business.

## Ruled shape for the skills lane — ⛔ not open for re-design

- `references/dispatch-runbook.md` 〈接手中断的 dev〉: one line — an account suspension is the dead-session case; the taker re-claims and re-renders any vanished record (claim / review / ruling) on the current head from the body's lines.
- `references/platform-readings.md` 〈API 配额〉 or the nearest reading block: one line — a suspension hides the account's comments fleet-wide with no timeline event; assignee, PRs and bodies persist; `pm:retriage` is the remedy for vanished triage.
- `references/seat-post-protocol.md` (or wherever the status block is spelled): one line — durable state lives in the body or is written as the App; the body stays under the relay's byte cap.
- ⛔ No new gate, hook, ratchet or roster; every line paid in place under the file's ceiling; `Clause-②: no`; `skip-changeset`; one PR `Fixes` this card; landed after the director's in-seat `## Contract review` (`Reviewed-by:` + `**VERDICT: PASS**`, the spelling the queue guard reads).
- Serial: PR #19737 (#19061 step ③, Tier H) holds `dispatch-runbook.md` and `platform-readings.md`; PR #19771 (#19739) holds `platform-readings.md` too — this card lands after both; the taker rebases then.

`suspended account dead session comments vanished` · `pm:retriage vanished triage` · `re-render contract review vanished author` · `durable state body or App identity` · `封号 席位账号 处理`
